name: Varus
notes: Living Vengeance (P) only grants its buff on a unit kill; the stationary dummy never dies during the fight, so the passive never triggers and is excluded from the rotation.
Skill max order is Q > W > E on Patch 16.21, matching Varus's primary marksman skill order and scaling Blighted Quiver's on-hit, stack detonation, and active missing-health damage.

Piercing Arrow (Q) scales in 10 discrete 0.125 s channel increments up to 1.25 s (+7% per step, up to +70% damage, Blight detonation, Blight cooldown refund, and W active missing-health damage). Starting the channel blocks attacks and other casts for the chosen charge duration, releasing the arrow applies the standard 0.25 s post-cast animation lockout, and Q's post-effect cooldown is reduced by the channel duration.

Instead of always holding Q for 1.25 s, the driver chooses the optimal discrete charge step k in 0..=10 on each cast: it releases as soon as a partial or tap charge (or tap plus imminent auto) secures a kill, takes any free charge steps that fit inside the current basic-attack cooldown, and only holds further when the marginal Q, Blight, W-active, and cooldown-refund gain beats the opportunity cost of delayed attacks.

Blighted Quiver (W) applies on-hit magic damage and 1 Blight stack per on-hit when ranked (up to 3 stacks, lasting 6 s). Detonating stacks with Q, E, or R deals per-stack max-health magic damage (using the 2.5% rank-0 base if W is unranked when R applies stacks) and refunds 11% of Q, W active, and E total cooldowns per stack (up to 18.7% per stack, 56.1% at 3 stacks, on a fully-charged Q).

Blighted Quiver's active (40 s cooldown, instant, does not trigger Spellblade) empowers the next Q to deal missing-health magic damage after Q's physical hit and Blight detonation; both Q's and W's cooldowns are set before applying Q's Blight detonation refund so Q self-refunds and refunds W's active properly.

Hail of Arrows (E) and Chain of Corruption (R) both have a 0.2419 s cast time. E lands 0.5 s after cast to deal physical damage and detonate Blight stacks, then detonates any newly applied Blight stacks a second time 0.3 s later. R deals magic damage, triggers Malignance Hatefog, detonates current Blight stacks, and applies 3 staggered Blight stacks at 0.65 s, 1.20 s, and 1.75 s.

When Varus can generate Blight stacks, E and Q wait for 3 stacks unless an immediate cast finishes the target, and E precedes Q when both are ready at 3 stacks so E consumes the initial stack set, puts E on cooldown to receive Q's Blight refund, and lowers target health before W's missing-health execute.
Mana costs are not modeled: none of Varus's costs constrain casting within a level 16 fight.
